Foundational Literacy and Numeracy - CISCE Resource Pack (not a prescribed syllabus)
DG-1 Children maintain good health and well-being (HW)
Development of healthy habits, hygiene, sanitation and awareness for self-protection
Development of fine motor skills and eye-hand coordination
Participation in games (individual and team) and sports
Prediction and use of previous experiences with knowledge
Independent reading for pleasure and various purposes
DG-3 Children become involved learners and connect with their immediate environment (IL)
Sensory development (sight, sound, touch, smell, taste)
Concepts related to the environment (natural, physical, social)
Concept formation (colours, shapes, distance, measurement, size, length, weight, height, time; spatial sense; one-to-one correspondence)
Shapes (2D, 3D, straight and curved line, plain and curved surfaces)
